text: El replicador aplica dos veces una entrada cuando el offset confirmado llega después de la reconexión. Seguí la carrera, corregí qué cursor se restaura y agregá una regresión determinista; no cambies batching ni rendimiento.
author: Codex
rationale: Repairs cursor correctness after reconnect.
contrast_note: Offset and batching terms describe a correctness boundary, not optimization.

text: A compactação grava o manifesto antes de tornar o segmento durável e uma queda deixa referências órfãs. Corrija a ordem de commit e cubra power loss mantendo formato e política de compactação atuais.
author: Codex
rationale: Fixes a durability ordering defect.
contrast_note: Compaction context does not request throughput or latency work.

text: The frame reader advances its byte offset before validating a truncated varint, so retry skips the first valid byte. Find the premature mutation and fix retry semantics with wire fixtures; preserve buffering behavior.
author: Codex
rationale: Corrects retry position after a truncated varint.
contrast_note: Byte and buffering vocabulary is about correctness, not speed.

text: La rotation renomme correctement le journal mais le gestionnaire d'erreur ferme le nouveau descripteur au lieu de l'ancien. Isolez l'identité inversée, corrigez-la et ajoutez un test de panne sans changer la fréquence de rotation.
author: Codex
rationale: Fixes descriptor identity during rotation failure.
contrast_note: Rotation frequency is explicitly preserved rather than optimized.

text: Nach der Wiederherstellung zählt der Scheduler dieselbe Generation zweimal und führt einen Job erneut aus. Verfolge die falsche Generation-ID und stelle Exactly-once wieder her; Scheduling-Intervalle bleiben unverändert.
author: Codex
rationale: Restores exactly-once scheduling after recovery.
contrast_note: Scheduler timing remains a preserved contract, not an optimization target.

text: Il calcolo della dimensione include due volte il tag di un union annidato e produce un length prefix invalido. Correggi il conteggio e aggiungi vettori golden, mantenendo allocazioni e strategia di emissione.
author: Codex
rationale: Fixes an invalid serialized length.
contrast_note: Size and allocation terms do not request performance tuning.

text: Separá posición lógica, offset físico y validación del cursor en tipos privados distintos. Conservá exactamente los seeks, errores, llamadas al sistema y bytes leídos del comportamiento sano.
author: Codex
rationale: Clarifies cursor concepts without behavioral changes.
contrast_note: Physical offsets and syscalls are equivalence constraints, not performance goals.

text: Extraia o planejamento e a aplicação da compactação para módulos internos separados. Ordem de arquivos, fsyncs, recuperação, métricas emitidas e seleção de segmentos devem permanecer idênticas.
author: Codex
rationale: Separates compaction phases while preserving semantics.
contrast_note: Metrics and compaction are explicitly held constant.

text: Move offset arithmetic and boundary validation behind a private value object. Keep generated machine code out of scope; public errors, accepted frames and read order must remain unchanged.
author: Codex
rationale: Encapsulates offset invariants without changing behavior.
contrast_note: Arithmetic is being reorganized, not optimized.

text: Regroupez ouverture, renommage et fermeture des journaux sous un propriétaire privé unique. Préservez appels, ordre, délais configurés, messages et contenu exact de chaque fichier.
author: Codex
rationale: Consolidates journal lifecycle ownership.
contrast_note: Configured delays are preserved and not tuned.

text: Kapsle Generation, Priorität und Queue-Position in einem internen Scheduler-Zustand. Gesunde Entscheidungen, Wakeups, Interleavings und Telemetrie müssen Bit für Bit gleich bleiben.
author: Codex
rationale: Encapsulates scheduler state with strict equivalence.
contrast_note: Queue and wakeup terminology does not imply tuning.

text: Sposta calcolo della lunghezza, emissione e aggiornamento dell'offset in componenti interni separati. Mantieni identici buffer, numero di write, byte e ordine degli errori.
author: Codex
rationale: Separates serializer responsibilities without behavioral changes.
contrast_note: The number of writes is a preservation condition, not an optimization request.

text: Investigá estrategias de recuperación para compactaciones interrumpidas. Compará papers y prototipos descartables por garantías de consistencia, complejidad y pérdida máxima; recomendá opciones sin modificar el motor.
author: Codex
rationale: Researches future recovery approaches.
contrast_note: Compaction failure scenarios are evaluated, not repaired or optimized in production.

text: Compare bibliotecas de codificação binária para um novo formato de arquivo. Meça tamanho, compatibilidade e clareza de erros em amostras isoladas, documentando incertezas sem trocar o serializador atual.
author: Codex
rationale: Compares codecs for a future format decision.
contrast_note: Size measurements rank candidates rather than optimize the current serializer.

text: Study log rotation libraries for container workloads. Reproduce rename, descriptor and crash behavior in throwaway fixtures, compare maintenance evidence, and report tradeoffs without changing our logger.
author: Codex
rationale: Evaluates rotation libraries before adoption.
contrast_note: Failure reproduction supplies comparative evidence, not a current bugfix or optimization.

text: Étudiez les représentations de curseurs pour une API de synchronisation future. Comparez stabilité, taille et reprise après expiration sur des prototypes isolés, puis rédigez une recommandation sans toucher au service.
author: Codex
rationale: Researches cursor representations for a future API.
contrast_note: Cursor size is comparative evidence, not current service optimization.

text: Untersuche Verfahren zur deterministischen Wiederherstellung von Scheduler-Zuständen. Vergleiche Literatur und kleine Wegwerfmodelle hinsichtlich Korrektheit und Nachweisbarkeit; ändere den Scheduler nicht.
author: Codex
rationale: Compares recovery methods without changing the scheduler.
contrast_note: Scheduler models gather evidence and do not tune runtime performance.

text: Valuta schemi di checksum per frame annidati consultando standard e implementazioni mantenute. Confronta copertura degli errori e overhead pubblicato, poi presenta opzioni senza modificare il protocollo.
author: Codex
rationale: Studies checksum schemes for a future protocol choice.
contrast_note: Published overhead is research evidence rather than a performance task.

text: Revisá el parche de recuperación del índice contra los invariantes y fixtures existentes. Señalá referencias huérfanas, orden durable incorrecto o tests insuficientes con evidencia del diff; no midas throughput ni corrijas.
author: Codex
rationale: Reviews a concrete recovery patch.
contrast_note: Recovery and durability analysis remains a bounded review.

text: Revise o diff que divide arquivos de backup em blocos numerados. Confira ordem, checksums, retomada e mensagens contra os fixtures anexados; não meça velocidade, proponha outro formato ou edite o código.
author: Codex
rationale: Reviews backup block semantics using supplied fixtures.
contrast_note: Block numbering and checksums are correctness evidence, not optimization signals.

text: Review the compaction pull request against the documented crash matrix and current file-order guarantees. Cite unsupported transitions and missing tests only; do not benchmark compaction or redesign storage.
author: Codex
rationale: Reviews compaction correctness against known guarantees.
contrast_note: Compaction review is not automatically performance work.

text: Relisez le diff de rotation des journaux avec les événements et descripteurs enregistrés dans les tests existants. Signalez les erreurs d'identité ou d'ordre, sans mesurer le débit ni appliquer de correctif.
author: Codex
rationale: Reviews rotation event ordering without implementation.
contrast_note: Descriptor and throughput terms do not change read-only authority.

text: Prüfe den Scheduler-Patch anhand der vorhandenen Generationstraces und Exactly-once-Invarianten. Melde nur belegte Reihenfolgefehler; führe keine Lasttests aus und ändere keine Prioritäten.
author: Codex
rationale: Reviews scheduling order using supplied traces.
contrast_note: Trace evidence and priorities are review subjects, not tuning objectives.

text: Esamina la modifica al parser usando i frame corpus e i conteggi di write già presenti nei test. Individua deviazioni da errori e ordine documentati, senza profilare, ottimizzare o correggere.
author: Codex
rationale: Reviews parser behavior using existing test artifacts.
contrast_note: Write counts are an existing invariant, not a performance request.
